feeds.title: My Handbound Books - Bookbinding Blog
feeds.description: Rhonda Miller is a bookbinder and book artist and she blog about her bookbinding projects and ambitions.

feeds.title: Paperiaarre
feeds.description: Blogger Kaija Rantakari showcases handmade books, different bookbinding techniques, mixed media art taking many shapes, as well as her love for all things old and beautiful. She hopes to inspire her fellow paper enthusiasts through her paper explorations.

feeds.title: Jeff Peachey Blog
feeds.description: Peachey is a independent book conservator and bookbinder. He also invents, makes, and sells bookbinding and conservation tools.

feeds.title: iBookBinding Bookbinding Tutorials & Resources
feeds.description: iBookBinding is a resource for bookbinders, papermakers and book art enthusiasts. Follow this blog to get insights on Bookbinding resources, videos, tutorials, supplier lists, book reviews, and more!

feeds.title: Ruth Bleakley's Studio Blog
feeds.description: Ruth Bleakley is a bookbinder and nautical stationery designer. She loves to pin, nautical weddings, bright colors and patterns, design and typography. She creates all of her work with her own hands the book covers are hand cut, the pages hand folded and the books are sewn together.

feeds.title: The Rag & Bone Bindery Blog - Playing With Books
feeds.description: Rag & Bone Bindery, home of beautiful handcrafted books and albums. They create exquisite handbound albums and journals to last a lifetime. Here you'll find news and different book designs from the binding team.

feeds.title: Blue Roof Designs Blog
feeds.description: Bookbinding blog by Elissa Campbell of Blue Roof Designs. Learn about her work in handmade books. Work includes Journals, photo albums, and guest books handmade using traditional bookbinding techniques.

feeds.title: Herringbone Bindery Blog
feeds.description: Erin Fletcher offers a wide range of bookbinding services from one-of-a-kind handcrafted items to multiple editions. This could include albums, portfolio cases, boxes and books with or without content. The Bindery is also equipped to offer basic conservation, which includes book repair for cloth, paper or leather and paper repair for single documents, pamphlets or books. This blog is an extension of Herringbone Bindery where she can share her inspirations with you.

feeds.title: han-made bookbinding
feeds.description: I am a self-employed bookbinder working from my home studio in Somerset. I work to commission creating unique bindings on books using a variety of skills including: leather work, embroidery, metalwork and carpentry, and try to write as much as I can about it here!

feeds.title: The American Bookbinders Museum Blog
feeds.description: The American Bookbinders Museum, located in the heart of San Francisco's SOMA district, is dedicated to showcasing bookbinding's history, craft, and practice.

feeds.title: London Bookbinding Blog
feeds.description: London Bookbinding supply bespoke bookbinding services. Using traditional and contemporary techniques and materials, we create custom bindings and boxes that perfectly complement the book's content. Here you'll find a variety of unique projects that have been created here in the bindery in recent years, you are sure to be inspired by this exciting and diverse collection. Keep up with all our latest news, custom projects and new collections by following our blog.

feeds.title: Welcome to Book Island
feeds.description: Juliayn Coleman is a bookbinder and book conservator relocated to the San Francisco Bay Area from the American Midwest. She encourages you to avoid slacking off today. Do as much as you can. Find articles on bookbinding in the modern age and beyond.

feeds.title: Jack & Taff Fitterer Blog
feeds.description: Since 1983 we have offered a full range of hand bookbinding and restoration services of extraordinary quality including repair and rebinding of antiquarian books. As bookbinders our aim is to assist you in preserving your books in the most appropriate way.

feeds.title: Sprouts Press Blog
feeds.description: Carolyn is a book binder, printmaker and love fancy papers. This is a place to learn about hand bound books, hand pulled prints and paper arts. Here you will find information on her upcoming shows, workshops and classes, the latest projects and other bookish goodies.

feeds.title: Bookbinder's Chronicle
feeds.description: A thing or two about Bookbinding & Restoration. A mystery bookbinder surrounded by dusty old books. MHR shares her personal records of life as a traditional bookbinder.

feeds.title: Bookbinding Now
feeds.description: Bookbinding Now is a community podcast posted every other Wednesday. It is hosted by Susan Mills in conjunction with Full Tilt Bookbinding Classes.

feeds.title: Conti Borbone bookbinder
feeds.description: Bookbinding Conti Borbone from 1873 binds books and sells handmade products including faux books, photo frames and leather inserts for desks. This blog is about book binding, desk subtitles, and other gold decorations.
